svg.aria-label: kumi: yui asks a question, states the plan, then runs design, build and review

text.tspan: /kumi:yui I want a button on my site that lets people sign up for updates
A couple of quick questions before I start. Where does the signup form go:
a page you already have, or a new one? And when someone signs up, should
their email just be saved somewhere for now, or does it need to go into a
mailing list tool you already use?
/kumi:yui An existing page. For now just save the emails in the project,
Here's the plan: an architect will design where the form and its data go
in your project, a developer will build the form and save the emails, then
a reviewer will check it before you ship. Go ahead?
(Design where the signup form and its data fit)
The design puts the form in the site footer and saves each email to
data/signups.json. Build it, or change something first?
/kumi:yui put the form under the hero section, not in the footer
(Move the signup form under the hero section)
Updated: the form now sits under the hero section. Build it?
(Build the form and save the emails)
Built and reviewed. The form is under the hero section and saves each
email to data/signups.json. The review found 2 minor issues and nothing
/yui I want a button on my site that lets people sign up for updates by
/yui An existing page. For now just save the emails in the project, no
